name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2613: REG-592. The printer reports PARTIAL and said only 14 reel(s) have a station nobody answered - which reads as a gap in the PRINTER. Measured on his shelf - all 14 are UNKNOWN at exactly ONE station, TEMPLATE, and every one has ZERO deep journal rows while carrying 22 to 2385 frames on disk and 7 to 40 SHALLOW rows. They were read and never read DEEPLY, so the input is missing and the river is working perfectly. v2604 taught the station to say that; the SUMMARY still only counted, so a reader acting on that sentence goes and investigates a component with nothing wrong with it. The summary now QUOTES the stations own reasons rather than paraphrasing them - a paraphrase would be a second copy of a fact. Proven RED by removing the detail, and it carries a baseline that a fully answered shelf appends NOTHING, because a sentence that is always there stops carrying information.
